challenge.better_approach: Considered only the attribute: an existing CRLF working copy stays CRLF until the file is rewritten, so the install would still lay CR. Considered installing through git show of the index blob: it ties install to a git index the installer otherwise never reads; folding CRLF on write is one line and covers both.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That no hook source needs a CR byte on purpose: they are bash scripts, which a CR breaks. And that the boxes then re-run cairn artifact install-hook, named in the READY.
challenge.prior_art: ticket daaf7ac3e4ec gave the tester's pre-commit its eol=lf line, and 383ac6351996 made the tester's install write bytes (cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_installed_hook_is_lf_on_every_box.py); this carries both to the artifact tool's hooks.
challenge.real_collision: None: the installed bytes change only where they held a CR, which bash could not run.

answers.falsifier: cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_the_artifact_hooks_install_lf_on_every_box.py: the attribute reads lf for every artifact hook, an autocrlf=true clone checks them out LF, and the installer lays LF from CRLF sources; red on the base. Horizon: akiendell's next install-hook lays a hook bash runs.
answers.how: Two halves, because an attribute alone does not rewrite a working copy already checked out CRLF. (a) .gitattributes gains 'cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/* text eol=lf', beside the tester's line. (b) In cairn/tools/artifact/__main__.py, every hook install (pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, commit-msg) writes the source's bytes with CRLF folded to LF, through one helper, instead of shutil.copyfile. The proof cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_the_artifact_hooks_install_lf_on_every_box.py reads the attribute for every file under cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/, checks out this tree's hooks and .gitattributes in a scratch repo cloned with core.autocrlf=true, and calls the installer in-process over a CRLF copy of each source.
answers.traces_to: Law 4: the artifact door is physics only where its hook runs, and a CRLF hook on a Windows box does not run.
answers.what: Every hook cairn artifact installs reaches .git/hooks as LF bytes, whatever line endings the box's checkout gave its source.

bullets.text: The artifact door runs nowhere on akiendell today: no hook is installed, and installing from its CRLF checkout would lay a broken one.
